g.text: Nanit Proof Layer: backend architecture (as built, 2026-10-11)

Independent engineering prototype. Synthetic data, simulated payments, not affiliated with Nanit. Solid arrow = a real code path (listed in ARCHITECTURE_EDGES.md; boards.py checks each one). Red dashed = failure and recovery path. Grey dashed = PROPOSED, not built.
